nom: Mario Badescu Glycolic Acid Toner with Grapefruit & Aloe

avis.texte: No matter what shape my skin is in I always find this refreshing and renewing.

avis.titre: I would bye the toner again
avis.texte: This is the second time I bought it and it makes my face feel so clean.

okay i usually dont use toners because i feel like they dont do anything on my skin but this toner right here is amazing! ive seen a difference within the first couple days. leaves your skin looking healthy and clear!! definetly reccomend

I switched all facial care January 2024. I haven't had breakouts like this since I was between 12 and 16! I returned it today *March 2024* for the Witch Hazel and Rose Water and hopefully this corrects the problem. My skin is of the normal sensitive type but this caused an influx of oil.
I was told if you're over 40, you should be using a toner twice a day. I am amazed at the results and wish I had started sooner!
I didn't notice any change in my skin's texture or pore size at all while using this for almost a month. It actually was making my skin oilier than when I wasn't using any toner at all.
Purchased on line and received half the bottle. Top of the bottle was not taped and half the liquid was in the baggie.

Unfortunately, this contains fragrance and colorants. But otherwise it's nice, gentle glycolic toner. It's not as effective as some of the stronger glycolic toners or pads, but it does not irritate my sensitive skin, and works well to keep it clear. And you can't beat the price!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: This is the best product I have used so far in diminishing dark spots. It seems to take a long time to get completely rid of them.
If you like just wiping blue water all over your face, than go for it. It doesn't do anything, literally. It's just like water.

avis.titre: I'm so happy I found this toner!
avis.texte: Day 2 & this toner makes me feel great when I see my glowing skin! I see immediate positive results! I really like this skin care line!

This is a real toner, not an "essence" that's become so popular. This MB w/Glycolic Acid works wonderfully for my acne & scar prone skin that's nearing 40. It brightens & leaves my skin looking healthy w/o over drying. All the MD toners work well.

avis.titre: Buy in bulk & refill small bottles
avis.texte: Love it. Used it for a year. I'm 44 and I enjoy that this makes me feel complete for my skin routine. I use it 4 to 5 days a week.

This is actually a toxic blue color, not the muted green shown in the picture. It contains a ton of artificial colors (check ingredients). It burns the skin and is reminiscent of skincare in the 80s...back when we thought rubbing a lemon dipped in salt on our face was a good idea lol

I have been using this toner for years now. It's the only product that has helped prevent little acne breakouts. It got rid of little acne bumps I had on my forehead. After cleansing & toner, it makes my face feel nice and clean. I use Mario Badescu's ace face wash. Best combo for face wash & toner!
I have been using this toner for years. It is affordable, yet effective. It has diminished the texture on my skin. Highly recommend.
I have used this for over 20 years back when it was Aqua Glycolic. It is effective in controlling acne. I even used it one summer to ease the discomfort of poison ivy.
currently use this with the glycolic foaming cleanser and i love the results. my acne scars are hardly visible.

avis.titre: Just what I need for daily exfoliation... I think?
avis.texte: Since this product is a gentle non invasive exfoliation, (from what I've read about it) it is a great way to get a nice mild "peel" for every day. Although I am not an expert, I feel safe using it on a daily basis, but I think it's best to follow up with a hyaluronic serum just to keep skin moisturized. It has a very mild scent and doesn't tingle or burn once applied.
this stuff burner my eyes sooo oo bad! even when I don't go near my eyes this stuff burns my eyes! unusable due to this issue. will be dumping out.

Bought this because the beauty adviser said it would help diminish my blackheads, even my skin tone & prevent further breakouts. It did the exact opposite! It hasn't done anything to my blackheads, my skin is all broken out with the little white pimples & my skin tone now has blotchy dark spots all over. I've been using this for about a week & it's getting returned!

I have mature skin so using this glycolic acid toner works wonders. Made my skin feel great and my makeup looks great! A tip someone shared with me: if you have dry heels rub someone of this with a cotton round. It will smooth your heels! Great buy!

Been my go to toner for about 4 years now. It can be drying for some, but not for me. I have contested skin and benefit from a lot of exfoliation. I think it could do without the fragrance, but I am very sensitive to fragrance in skin care and it doesn't irritate me.

avis.titre: Another great product from Mario badescu
avis.texte: Am using this twice daily and my aging skin has never looked better!

avis.titre: A LIFESAVING product for acne scars
avis.texte: This product is by far the only product that can give me a noticeable difference in a few uses. It makes your skin glow, calms irritation, and brightens up acne scars. Truly amazing! Been using this for years and I'll never go back!

Ok, so I bought this because an Ulta employee raved about how it made her skin so soft! I was desperate for something to help with little bumps I had all over. I had recently moved to Texas and the heat messed with my skin! I started using this and within a week I noticed such a difference! Helped with my pores + texture. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

I used this toner after my college daughter recommended I use a toner as part of my skin care regimen. I honestly didn't think I needed another product but I was pleasantly surprised by this toner. My skin is brighter and my pores smaller after only a week's worth of use.
Definitely helped even out my skin tone, and helps minimize texture around my nose and under my eyes. Just a great everyday toner.

avis.titre: Burned my skin and had a bad allergic reaction
avis.texte: Horrible! Burned my skin for days AND caused an allergic reaction. My eyes were so swollen and developed a rash. Threw in the trash immediately.
I used to have some fine lines from tanning beds and this toner has helped them so much. You can barely see them anymore and cannot feel them at all. I also wear sunscreen and don't tan anymore!
Doesn't have much of a scent removes dirt and leaves skin feeling perky
I've purchased at least 3 times! It makes my skin feel so refreshed, clean and helps me maintain a better skin texture.

When I run out of this and go to any other toner I have on hand, my skin is noticeably less clean feeling all day every day. This truly cleans the skin without irritating it or stripping it of moisture as many toners do.

I didn't notice a difference in my skin, I have normal and slightly sensitive skin, with some color irregularity. And I was hoping it would clear up some of my red bumpiness near my jawline, but I didn't really do anything. I was worried it would irritate my skin, but it didn't. so I'm giving it a higher review because it didn't irritate my skin. It might irritate your skin if you have more sensitive skin than me.

avis.titre: Great even for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: My skin has become acne prone as of Feb. 2020 and I struggled for a long time trying to get my skin care routine down. This toner was recommended to me and it's been amazing (actively using for 2.5 months now). My skin is sensitive and dry. While the toner is slightly on the drying side, with a great moisturizer, it'll be no problem at all.

I've been using this at night for over 5 years, and I don't see myself stopping. I'm in my late 20's with oily combo/acne prone skin, and this really helps. I feel that it helps prevent fine lines, and it definitely helps texture and breakouts. It also makes my skin feel refreshed and balanced. Definitely recommend!

I love a lot Mario B. products including this one. The only reason I gave it 3/5 stars is because for ME it was a tad bit too strong, thus drying out my already 52 yo fall/winter skin. I did exchange for my usual Rose Toner by Mario B.
As the title indicates, I use this with the glycolic cleanser and I love these two products for helping keep my breakouts at bay while also helping to balance my skin. These two are my go to.

I have very congested, oily (but dehydrated) skin, and this product has been a godsend! I recommend starting slow, as it can irritate more sensitive skin types (although it's not as harsh as many other toners). But I use it every night after cleansing before treatments, and cannot express how great this makes my skin look and feel! My pores and texture have never looked better, and I don't get that awful tight feeling that other toners often leave me with. I'll never be without this product again!

I've tried countless toners in the last 5 years none impressed me until now. It's as if this was the missing puzzle piece in my skin care regimen. My skin looks so different, way more even tone and texture. I never want to stop using this! Start slow ppl! I started with ever other night for a few weeks, then every night, now I use this almost every morning and night. When my skin is feeling extra dry I do take a break. Remember this does serve as a chemical exfoliator. I have dry, sensitive, acne scarred skin, plus hormonal acne once in a while. This stuff works soo well for me.

I don't like to use this product in the morning just because it can react with sunlight. I use it after I shower and before I moisturize. I generally use a cotton ball to apply but sometimes that can be too rough and abrasive and cause irritation or burning. Follow the directions and do a skin patch test before applying to your face. It is a mild resurfacing toner so it is a little more harsh, so I would read the ingredients before fully committing especially if your skin is sensitive. I have combo skin and I have tried it alone and with moisturizer afterward, and it tends to make my skin oily either way but since I'm sleeping it's not a big deal.

Been using it for about 2 weeks after I ran out of Inkey List's PHA toner and transitioned seamlessly. I use it in the morning, and I like it's refreshing fragrance - not too strong or overwhelming. the glycolic formula is gentle and effective. I think I found my new favorite.
I bought this toner after reading reviews. I'm in my 40's and felt I needed an extra boost. This product is helping my skin get fully refreshed after cleaning.

I've been experimenting with toners lately and I really love how this GA toner has cleared up my combination skin and improved its texture. I use it both morning and evening after cleansing. Just a few drops on a cotton ball then sweep a light layer all over face and neck.
I feel the product is working well but I would've liked to have known it is very scented, so it may deter some from purchasing it.

avis.titre: I am loving this for my dry skin!
avis.texte: I was a little scared to use this at first, but honestly my skin has never looked better. Stings a little bit at the very beginning but the feeling went away in less than 10 seconds.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel fresh and clean
avis.texte: I use this product morning and night after cleansing. I have not experienced and dryness or breakouts while using this product. My skin feels super fresh and clean!

avis.titre: Perfect if you don't use too much
avis.texte: This is definitely my go-to toner. I've been using it for a year or two now. The thing that I've learned though is if you have more sensitive skin like I do, you have to keep the application to a minimal. Like only a couple drops onto a cotton ball or else it might irritate your skin. But other than that it's really helped improve my acne and it doesn't make my skin oily or dry and it's super refreshing to apply.

Ever since my favorite glycolic toner made by DDF was discontinued, I have been searching for another glycolic toner to replace it. I really thought this could be the one. Unfortunately, I did not like it. Starting with the terrible smell. But also, my skin felt blah after using it. I will stick to Clinique for now. My skin feels super fresh and fabulous after using it.
It's a really bad brand, out of all of their products there's like only one good one. DONT BUY
Only been using for a few days and already feel a difference in my skin. Fine lines are smoothing our and my complexion looks smoother.

avis.titre: Good performance, lasts a long time!
avis.texte: Obviously if you are not a toner person then this is not the product for you. I give it 4 stars because this has ingredients that some people may find issue with such as parabens. I work in the chemical industry so if I'm getting cancer it's not going to be from my skincare. Besides that, it's the bottle lasts a long time and the toner always picks up any remaining dirt and oils that are on my face whenever I try using a lower quality cleanser to save money.

avis.titre: I would NOT buy this again
avis.texte: I never use toner because I have very dry skin but I wanted to try to add something into my skin care routine so I decided to try this one since I've loved all the mario badescu products I have used in the past. I thought the ingredients would not irritate my skin because of the aloe and other ingredients in it that i have used before. After a few days of using this, my skin became extremely dry and flaky and would burn so bad every time I washed it or put other product on. My skin is still recovering right now, after trying to just intensely moisturize i eventually had to turn to cortisone ointment and benadryl to help the burning and itching sensation, which has seemed to help turn my skin back to normal. I don't normally have sensitive skin but if you do I would not recommend trying this!!!

I have clear n clean skin but a little bit dull. I bought this toner for brighting my skin, it gave me worst ache on my face that never happened before. Had big red pus pimples on all over my face. And now throw it out.
I use this toner every other night or so on spots where i have acne or oiliness and it's awesome. It's strong so I don't use it all the time or everywhere but it's worth having

Used this toner previously with less than favorable results. Face broke out horribly...from overuse. Definitely have to follow the directions to get the best results. The dark spots on my face a clearing up nicely, my skin is smooth and pores aren't clogged. I have combination skin that is part oily and part dry. I use this at night after washing my face at bedtime. So glad I gave this another chance!

I normally use the Clean & Clear Oil-Free Deep Cleaning Astringent toner but i want to try something different so I gave this a shot. Plus I was wanting to improve my skincare. I was excited when it arrived and started using it right away. I have notice my skin is breaking out WAY more than it used to in a few days/weeks. It made my eyes/bags area extremely sensitive,my nose is starting to break out way more. I recommend the Clean & Clear one because it actually does something and you would feel it cleaning your skin. (It may burn a little but all the mean is the product is take the rest of the dirt that's deep in your pores and skin.)
I've used this toner for morning/night for several months and have seen tremendous improvement is the texture of my skin. Especially for the price, this is a must have product!

I wanted to try since it was highly recommended but only after 3 days of using my skin started to dry dramatically. Looks like my skin is about to peel off! I did feel my face a lot cleaner but unfortunately it just wasn't for me.
This is a fantastic product and I recommend to all my friends!
This broke me out and irritated my skin within a week of using
It's cleared up the red spots on my face! And it's not super drying!
I just started using this toner and my skin has been less irritated nor red. Also has helped with my dryness and large pores
I just started using this toner and it's working better than any other one I've ever used. Has a nice smell and doesn't tingle like other toners!

I love Mario Badescu products and this one is no different. I can feel it do its work immediately after putting it on my skin. I usually let it absorb for a couple minutes before applying moisturizer or serum and it works and feels wonderful. I love my skincare regimen and it would not be the same without this toner.
This toner is amazing on my skin. I have combinations. This does not dry out my skin, its getting rid of those small bumps. I will defend buy it again

So since we've been home on quarantine I've had more time to pay attention to my skin and I've been following the directions on this product and using it twice a day after washing my face. And my skin looks great!! I got my glow back!! I'm 41 and my face had looked a little dull but now my skin feels fresh and I got my glow back!! Will certainly get more as soon as they have it in.

This toner is a big no for my face. So I wanted to add a toner to my routine since I didn't have one and decided to go for this based on the reviews. Well right after I washed and cleaned my face, I went in with the toner and my face immediately started tingling then it turned red and it started to burn. I quickly washed it off. I know it wasn't my cleanser cause I've been using it for months. The only new step added to my routine was this toner. I did patch tested it on my forearm and nothing happened. Read the ingredients and it has alcohol and it's also heavily fragranced which is another big no no for the face.

For context, I'm in my early thirties, I have combination skin, and I'm prone to random zits during "that time". I was looking for a toner to help even my tone and texture, something to use after or between face washing. My skin can get dry with particular products, but I also need to ensure I'm keeping the oil at bay. This works great, it's not harsh, and my skin has been very smooth and even since using over the last couple of weeks.
I love how soft this makes my skin feel. I use it after washing my face and before bed.
I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and this works really well. It doesn't irritate my skin and it even helps with my acne. I always notice my skin looks clearer almost instantly after using this.
it's really big and nice to have and use. I really recommend it. Works on my skin perfectly.

avis.titre: First time user and I will never use any other toner
avis.texte: I've tried many toners my last favorite was a smoothing toner by PCA skincare for years but this toner wins hands down.

I recently started toning my face. With this one I feel and see a difference! Whereas thayers did nothing for my skin..Very clean feeling and almost a tightening of the skin once it drives. Will continue to use !!

I use this every morning and night and find that if I don't use it, my skin breaks out a lot more with different cleansers I try. Therefore, it not only helps with breakouts but with acne scarring too. I love it (as my title indicates).

A little swipe of this on a cotton pad has really upped my face game. Smaller pores, way smoother skin, non irritating. Using it twice a day as my first toner (I follow with the badescu lavender mist, great combo!) I'm an instant fan, improvement in skin quality day #1
Great product. Noticed my face look better. Seems to help with fine lines.
Glides on feels clean but does not strip skin. Can see why all give 5 stars.only wish it came in a larger size

I'm really disappointed that a well known skincare brand like this has ingredients that I don't want anywhere on my skin. Especially if you're going to use it twice a day on your face. I want my skin care to be as clean as possible. This has parabens and multiple types of alcohols in it! Like ARE YOU SERIOUS?

I started using this product last year and it completely changed my skin. Break outs are greatly reduced, and my skin feel fresh and clean. I have my teen son using it now and he's seeing a big difference, too.

Bought this 3 times already, which is a record for me! Doesn't break me out, and it helps with existing acne too. It's light, and helps a "little" bit with my dark spots. Not a ton, but a little. All in all, it's great!

I love this toner as it really removes stuff after cleansing and really preps skin for essence and serums. You can feel the difference after using this with your skin. This is great for mature skin and helps with lines and wrinkles. I am going to use this permanently when I finish my TO Glycolic toner. it is worth the extra dollars. I only use at night.

avis.titre: Gave me terrible red bumps all over my skin
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product, I really did and thought it would be a great addition to my skincare routine. Mario Badescu products are very raved about and I myself love the rose facial spray. This product, however, was a very disappointing purchase. Upon getting home and trying it out, I could not wait to try it and noticed it had a very strong smell. I know its a glycolic toner but the smell was just too strong. I tried it over the course of a week only to notice that after a week's use my skin was completely filled with tiny red bumps all over and they were now turning into red patches. Obviously a sign of skin irritation, borderline allergic reaction. I did some research and found beyond the raving reviews of MB products that people would also report this, it was also mentioned that Mario Badescu products seem to have unknown or weird ingredients which is sad for such reputable brand and spa. I discontinued right away and returned promptly.

avis.titre: I am going to continue to buy this product
avis.texte: I use this product after I double cleanse, exfoliate and derma blade my face in the morning and evening. Right away you can feel it working! It doesn't strip my face and make it dry and crackly it's very light weight yet it does it's job. I can see my skins complexion evening after a week of using it. However, I wish they did make a travel size version that was affordable!

This toner is amazing! After about 2 days of using as directed, my T-zone (with makeup) hardly ever gets oily. I used to have to reapply my foundation a couple of times throughout the day, but now I only blot the minimal amount of oil on my nose with my fingers. Never going back!
Gets my face ready for moisturizer and makeup. Clean and refreshing

I own 2 other products by the MB brand that I adore and cannot live without. I bought this one without reading the ingredients. It has FD&C coloring in, so I returned it. I'm sure it would've worked great, but I don't use products with artificial colors/dyes.
i don't have sensitive skin, i rarely breakout from products but this made me break out like crazy.
This is a great toner, makes skin feels so fresh and clean. Great price too. However, this product is suppose to reduce acne scarring and dark spots. Went through 2 bottles, no changes. I'm moving on

I read the reviews, and though I have fairly sensitive skin, not many things make me break out. However, a little while after I started using this product, I broke out. Like, teenage break out, break out. My face is covered in acne - huge, painful breakouts. Nothing has changed in my routine except for this toner, and like some of the other reviews about this toner, my skin is FREAKING OUT. I'm going to stick to the other wonderful toners by Mario Badescu, but I'm absolutely skipping this one unfortunately.

avis.titre: Didn't know I can be in love with a product!
avis.texte: I was having terrible breakouts, using drug store face washes daily but I purchased the entire line and this product stands out most! After washing, I apply this with a cotton ball, I love that you can see the extra dirt and the tingle that it gives! Before purchasing my breakouts were so bad that I couldn't put make up over them. The toner completely dries them out and makes them disappear within just a few hours! My face hasn't looked this great in months!

I bought this to help diminish age spots on my face. Only used it twice. It made my age spots much worse! Made them red and more prominent. Accomplished the opposite of what I was hoping in only two applications.

I deal with hormonal acne that sprouts up like CRAZY on my chin. I've been cleaning my face twice a day and once I added this to my routine the acne has really eased up. I'm prone to dry skin and this doesn't dry me out. very happy with this toner.

So far I am loving this stuff. I have only had it 4 days but i do notice a subtle difference. I am a huge fan of this product line so I also use several of his other products. I only use it at night after i have washed my face but this product hasn't made me break out which is huge! People complain about the smell but honestly i think it smells good, not overpowering.

avis.titre: Bye bye pore strips!  Hello smooth and radiant skin!
avis.texte: After just one use of MB glycolic cleanser and toner, I was shocked to feel how smooth my face was. Having combo skin, I needed to use pore strips regularly.in the T-zone to clean my pores Face is crazy smooth compared to before usage and it leaves a radiant glow.. No more pore strips for me! (I use the toner every evening and the foaming cleanser every other evening). Quite impressive results!

I use this toner every morning. I use a more "heavy duty" AHA toner at night. I've been using this for awhile now, probably 2 or 3 years. I've switched and tried other toners but I always go back to this. I like it for morning because it's only slightly tingly, it feels gentle on my skin, doesn't dry my skin out, feels energizing, and I also feel like it helps my serums sink into my skin more effectively. It has 3% Glycolic Acid, which I feel is the perfect amount for daily use without being "too much". I really have enjoyed all the products I've tried from Mario Badescu, they are fairly priced and really seem to work, this toner is definitely my favorite product from the line though!

I've been using this for about two or three months now. I use it twice a day and have notice that my skin looks a little brighter and livelier. It isn't bad but the reason I rate it this low is due to the pigmentation there is no reason to put color into glycolic acid. As for scent it's not over powering but, if you're sensitive to it it's a little bit of a more herbal smell? So it's not as bad. My skin was sensitive to it for the first couple weeks so I'd put moisturizer and a sleeping mask over it to cool down my skin; it's only 2% concentration it's not terrible it does work but if you like very basic skin care... I'd say maybe skip out and go with the Ordinary 5% if you're not sensitive I'll be switching to that soon. For reference I'm 20, with fair to light skin, freckled with oily skin in the summer, dry and flaky in the winter. With the cold coming it doesn't help much with my skin flaking, but it helps with keeping a nice subtle glow to my skin. Just an FYI if it actually burns your skin, take it off immediately, what I experienced wasn't a burning sensation but light redness and tingling as my skin is also very sensitive and not used to chemical exfoliating.
I noticed a difference after the first night I used it. I woke up with glowing skin! Buy this!

avis.titre: Will never use another toner again!!!
avis.texte: Been using this for a couple months. I've tried several different toners and this is the first one that has made my acne subside! I LOVE IT!! I
Very good toner, my acne spots and black heads gone in less than 2 months. At first it did irritate my skin a bit because I wasn't used to the glycolic acid. Give it time to do its magic.

Went in store to buy this. It looks like they redid the formula because there are less ingredients and no longer a color, but still the same product. It made my face very smooth but I couldn't even keep it on because of the heavy fragrance. Washed it off and still can't get rid of that smell.

I love this toner. I'm so glad someone at Ulta recommended it to me. It helps keep my acne away and helps to get rid of those old scars. Fair warning, I have oily skin and even this is a little drying for me. So do not use it you have dry sensitive skin. Also be careful to not apply even close to your eyes. It kinda has the same effect as sunscreen and can irritate your eyes.

avis.titre: Gentle but effective for my fair skin
avis.texte: Not irritating on my fair, sensitive skin. Works as advertised leaving clean, smooth skin for serums and makeup
Love this Product! Love how it evens out my skin tone! I was worried since I have sensitive skin that it would irritate my skin but it hasn't and I'm very pleased!
I've bought so many bottles of this. Makes my skin feel so soft. No more bumps or rough spots.
I'm hooked on this toner because I feel the clean fresh feeling it leaves my face even thought it drys my face i moisturize so it even out.

I wanted to love this product, but after trying it for a few weeks the only thing I saw were massive breakouts. I usually have pretty clear skin too, so this was super unusual. I wished it worked for me like it did for so many others. Never buying this product again.

I have dry, sensitive skin, partly oily, some pimpels, a lot pores and first, not so small anymore, wrinkles. This toner is gentle and leaves my skin super clean, refreshed and brightened. I use it for a week now and I got not a single new pimple, my pores seem smaller and old acne wounds and scars begin to disappear. My skin does not feel dry after use! Love it!

I waited a month to post a review because I wanted to see if this toner actually worked like other reviewers said and guess what, IT DOES! I am a 50 yo medium light olive skin woman with not only hyperpigmentation spots on my nose but also Melasma on my cheeks. This toner in a month has completely changed/lightened my spots on my nose. They went from dark brown to barely there. As for my cheeks anyone with Melasma knows that it is very hard to treat/get rid of and I am turning to prescription hydroquinone to help my discoloration. As for this toner it smells refreshing, feels cool/fresh on the skin and for the price you get a huge bottle. Bonus for me is that it works without drying out my skin.
